ambiguities.text: The specification references EIP-2124 for forkid validation logic but does not fully specify the validation algorithm inline.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume full EIP-2124 validation rules apply: forkHash derived from CRC32 of genesis plus fork block numbers, forkNext indicating next scheduled fork.

ambiguities.text: The statement 'disconnect immediately' does not specify which disconnect reason code should be used.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume a dedicated disconnect reason for fork incompatibility should be used, or existing 'Incompatible network' reason applies.

implicit_assumptions.description: Peers honestly report their forkid in the Status message.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Malicious peers could lie about fork configuration to waste connection slots or perform eclipse attacks.

implicit_assumptions.description: All nodes have accurate knowledge of past and upcoming fork block numbers.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Nodes with incorrect fork configuration may fail to connect to legitimate peers or connect to incompatible ones.

implicit_assumptions.description: The forkid mechanism provides sufficient protection against connecting to nodes on incompatible forks.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Nodes may still synchronize incompatible blocks before detecting the fork divergence.
